notes.title: Day 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287700/18c3a64de5449df56cdf6ee980a90f8ec5fd07de.png[/img]

Hello!
 
It's been almost 24 hours since Under the Moon was released! We are committed to continuing to improve the Under the Moon until we give you the best experience. That's why we listened to your feedback and tried to fix the issues with the day one patch.
 
[b]We've fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Achivement bugs are fixed
Sound problems are fixed in maps
- Germany loop problem is fixed
- Turkish language problem is fixed
- Level Design problems are fixed (NPC stuck problem)
[/list]

[b]Thank you for believing and trusting us! Under the Moon will come to a much better game with your feedback.[/b]

notes.title: Under the Moon v1.0 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287700/e5c5508f41c49efe75d9ea2569248e5811862e6b.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that we accomplished to get v1.0 with the Under the Moon in just 6 months! Thank you for all your support and feedbacks! 

We fix all the bugs that affect your gameplay and add new levels for you to enjoy. Now you can play the rest of the story of Ali Kemal and Leyla. 

In the new chapters you will experience Germany and Scotland with new riddles to solve. Thank you again for this beatiful journey! See you on the other projects!

- The Pack Studios and Bamya Games Teams
